Data extraction: CSV rows are positional Sequence nodes with indexed cells

```typescript title="TypeScript"

function main() {
  const config: ProcessConfig = { dataExtraction: true, language: "csv" };
  const result = process("a,b,c\n1,2,3\n", config);
  console.log(result.data);
  console.log(result.data?.kind);
  console.log(result.data?.children);
}
```
